purpose: Configure saved application preferences and browser-local workspace, appearance, typography, confirmation and connection behavior, with discovery and guarded recovery actions.
primaryGoal: Find the correct category, change a preference without losing a draft, understand its persistence scope, and safely save or reset it.

dataSources.name: Saved application settings
dataSources.behavior: Shared ['settings'] query; read forwards AbortSignal; full AppSettings save invalidates and broadcasts the settings query. General edits use a persistent draft; appearance controls merge a loaded snapshot and save immediately. Backend replacement/validation semantics were not independently inspected.

dataSources.name: Vehicle display preferences
dataSources.behavior: safeArray vehicle list; preferences read disabled without an ID. Sync uses first returned vehicle, not workspace selection; selectively copies detected display units and immediately saves the complete form. Clock preference is read-only.

dataSources.name: Workspace preferences and vehicle choices
dataSources.behavior: Browser-local teslasync:product-preferences:v1 external store; persona is presentation, never authorization. Landing applies on fresh root entry; selecting a default vehicle changes global selection, and changing analysis preset dispatches global scope immediately. Missing saved vehicle remains an explicit option.

dataSources.name: Browser typography, status bar, celebrations and confirmations
dataSources.owner: Existing FontProvider, status-bar and celebration preference hooks, confirmSilence; consumed by the settings feature
dataSources.behavior: Independent local sources apply immediately. Optional TypographyAgent provider supplies harmonic scale/HUD. Font preview may load an external stylesheet; system/custom installed fonts work offline. Source providers themselves were not exhaustively audited.

dataSources.name: Destructive reset
dataSources.behavior: Live-only mutation, existing request-layer sudo interception, cancel distinguished from error, normalized receipt, global query invalidation; section body versus empty global-reset body. No reset was executed.

dataSources.name: Server and onboarding actions
dataSources.behavior: Connection display comes from current remote mode; change navigates to /connect; disconnect clears saved connection and reloads root. Tours/checklist use existing dispatch/reset mechanisms. No production action exercised.

components.name: PageLayout
components.use: Existing PageContainer adapter, query and header actions; full-width min-w-0 container.

components.name: SettingsNavigation and SettingsSearch
components.use: Mobile category Select, desktop navigation, keyboard combobox and existing search index.

components.name: SettingsSummaryBrief
components.use: OperationalBrief and useOperationalMetrics; seven raw configuration metrics, loading/unavailable/retained labels.

components.name: SettingsActionCard
components.use: Three overview shortcut cards using GlassPanel, IconBox, native anchor or shared Button.

components.name: Settings forms
components.use: GeneralSettings, WorkspacePreferencesSettings, AppearanceSettings, TypographySettings, AdvancedSettings, ServerSection and ResetSection remain mounted across category switches.

components.name: UI/form primitives
components.use: GlassPanel, Button, Input, Select, Toggle, RadioCard, Slider, Textarea, Heading/Text/role wrappers, HelpIcon, ThemePicker, Accordion, ConfirmDialog, CurrencyInput and PersonaSelect; no new primitive proposed.

components.name: Feedback and motion
components.use: QueryError, DataStateNotice, EditConflictBanner, DraftRecoveryBanner, EmptyState, Skeleton, Toast and FadeIn.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Feature field wrapper duplicates existing label/control/feedback ownership; calls commonly omit htmlFor. Existing FormField already injects control identity and description IDs.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Prefer Input label/hint directly for simple inputs; compose existing FormField and HelpIcon for composites, preserving explicit IDs, CurrencyInput aria labels and help.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local Segmented helper manually styles repeated pressed Buttons, while appearance uses existing RadioCard. These express related but not necessarily identical selection contracts.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Evaluate reuse of existing RadioCard/group semantics before proposing shared work; preserve pressed-state keyboard behavior and typography-specific immediate changes.

sourceStrategy.detail: One column below lg; desktop 15rem navigation plus minmax(0,1fr); search w-full and sm:w-72.
Labeled category Select below lg; sticky button nav at lg. All eight categories retained.
Auto-fit shortcut grid with min(100%,18rem); action labels wrap and use minimum 44px height.
Single-to-two-column forms at sm; fuel price wraps with flexible basis and fixed fuel-unit Select.
Font families split only at 2xl; spacing controls stack below sm, but inner segmented groups remain three columns.
Font list has bounded vertical scrolling and one/two/three columns; focus preview exists, not hover-only.
Reset rows retain description and action in a horizontal flex row; global reset footer stacks below sm.

issues.detail: Always-three-column segmented controls and nested sm three-column outer grouping need long-label/200% text checks; source alone cannot prove clipping or adequate targets.
issues.fix: Validate at the ten contract widths and constrained shell widths; allow wrapping/stacking if measured overflow occurs without hiding choices.

issues.detail: Long destructive descriptions share a row with icon and reset action; narrow-width reachability remains unverified.
issues.fix: Exercise long translations and 320px before deciding whether to wrap the action row.

sourceStrengths: Named category navigation and aria-controls; mobile labeled Select (SettingsNavigation.tsx:18-36).
Search combobox/listbox IDs, active descendant, ArrowUp/Down, Enter, Escape and click-outside handling (SettingsSearch.tsx:52-64,95-140).
Appearance radiogroups and named/described status-bar and celebration toggles (AppearanceSettings.tsx:140-142,238-239,336-388,411-474).
Per-prompt Restore accessible name disambiguates rows (AdvancedSettings.tsx:109-120).
Destructive confirmation and typed RESET protection use existing ConfirmDialog (ResetSection.tsx:429-465).
Font selection exposes pressed state and focus-triggered preview; specimen Textarea has a label (FontFamilyPicker.tsx:78-85; TypographySpecimen.tsx:45-52).

issues.detail: Timezone override Input is enclosed in SettingField without htmlFor or its own label/aria-label. Comparison MPG has the same structure at line 408; SettingField does not inject an ID.
issues.fix: Give Input its native shared label/hint API or connect explicit control IDs through existing FormField. Keep all saved field names and values.

issues.detail: Explicit smooth scroll is unconditional, unlike shared FadeIn's reduced-motion behavior. Search fallback repeats the smooth-scroll path.
issues.fix: Honor existing motion preference in both hash-scroll and same-hash search fallback without losing deep links or timing cleanup.

issues.detail: Listbox options are focusable Buttons inside list items; arrow handling belongs to the input. Actual Tab/Enter order and announcement coherence need browser/screen-reader proof.
issues.fix: Test combobox focus retention, option activation, Escape, outside dismissal and category landing using existing controls; do not introduce another overlay engine.

unverified: Keyboard/focus restoration across category changes and dialogs

initialLoading.detail: Summary suppresses loading measurements; General has five skeletons. Other local panels remain independently mounted.

emptyUnavailable.detail: Missing saved preferences become dash/null values; independent font preferences remain real local data. Confirmation list and font search have specific empty copy.

fatalError.detail: Initial failure gets QueryError with refetch; exact PageContainer suppression/composition was not audited.

staleOffline.detail: Refresh error or paused retained data derives stale, retains payload and shows DataStateNotice plus retained brief. No explicit page-specific offline differentiation; local preferences are independent.

draftConflict.detail: Page edit lease; draft survives mount/navigation with recovery, 800ms debounce, 24h maximum and navigation guard. Hidden mounted panels deliberately preserve unsaved edits.

mutation.detail: Shared mutation toasts, pending controls, General inline success; appearance server-backed choices disabled without loaded settings or during pending save.

reset.detail: Independent pending section/global dialogs, typed confirmation, success receipt, error toast and silent sudo cancellation.

serverError.detail: Storage-clear failure shows role=alert instead of redirecting.

issues.detail: Save disabled condition only checks cost validity, not absence of settings or initial loading. DEFAULT_FORM remains available when no server snapshot exists; page-level error is not a local write guard.
issues.fix: Prevent full-form saves until a trustworthy settings snapshot/draft policy is established; preserve existing defaults as defaults, never present them as fetched configuration.

issues.detail: Sync units announces success immediately after mutate, before request success, and General save supplies toasts on top of hook-level success/error toasts.
issues.fix: Emit outcome feedback only on resolved mutation and choose one existing toast owner while retaining inline saved feedback.

issues.detail: useSelectedVehicle exposes an empty-array fallback but no query error/loading status; vehicle options cannot visibly distinguish empty fleet from initial/failed list in this consumer.
issues.fix: Reuse the existing vehicle query evidence alongside local preferences if integration needs distinct states; do not replace browser preferences with the fleet error.

visualIssues.detail: Export link explicitly requests colored GlassPanel hover glow. Prior shared-card migration is present but link decoration remains.
visualIssues.fix: Use restrained existing surface/focus treatment and remove caller-requested decorative glow, preserving whole-card navigation.

visualIssues.detail: Sync banner uses neon border/background/icon and clock banner uses fixed-white surfaces; these are residual decoration, not reasons to reset saved theme IDs.
visualIssues.fix: Use neutral surface/border and subdued meaningful icon tokens; retain car-preference information and actions.

visualIssues.detail: Dropdown requests shadow-2xl/backdrop-blur-xl, fixed-white selected/hover backgrounds and an ad-hoc text-xs empty row.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing neutral surface/focus/typography tokens without changing results or keyboard navigation.

visualIssues.detail: Raw field label uses ad-hoc text-xs/font-medium/tracking-wider instead of shared label role.
visualIssues.fix: Consolidate with existing field/label primitives while fixing association; no new typography scale.

architectureIssues.detail: KNOWN UNRESOLVED title namespace collision: useTranslation('settings') still calls unqualified t('title', 'Settings') for document title at line 86 and PageLayout at line 214. Runtime resources are flat translation with fallbackNS='translation'; root title is 'Command center', while canonical routes.settings is 'Settings'. This audit does not fix either call.
architectureIssues.fix: Future assigned implementation should use existing canonical routes.settings for both titles, then validate cold and loaded locale behavior. No new catalog or namespace.

architectureIssues.detail: General form hydrates server settings once. Appearance independently submits whole-snapshot merges, and resets invalidate settings; retained General draft can remain based on older values. Edit lease warns across tabs but source does not prove same-page snapshot reconciliation.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve draft recovery while testing General edit plus appearance save/reset sequences; reconcile source changes through existing draft/query policy rather than inventing a second settings store.

competingImplementations.name: SettingField versus shared FormField
competingImplementations.disposition: Reuse existing field owner; do not add a third wrapper.

competingImplementations.name: Two useVehicles hooks share ['vehicles'] but declare different interfaces
competingImplementations.disposition: Existing competing hook ownership is source-confirmed; actual cache-shape effects unverified. Preserve current first-car sync and workspace default behavior unless explicitly authorized to change.

competingImplementations.name: UI density and typography-agent density
competingImplementations.disposition: Distinct server setting and optional typography agent dispatch; do not collapse or rename persistence to remove apparent duplication.

competingImplementations.name: Tour launcher and direct replay controls
competingImplementations.disposition: Distinct discover/replay/reset actions; preserve all, not a deletion opportunity.

actions: Eight category selections preserve pathname/search and replace hash history.
Search substring/keyword/fuzzy results, maximum eight; ArrowUp/Down, Enter, Escape and same-hash fallback.
Overview export /data-export, tour launcher and checklist restart with toast.
General change fields, recover/discard draft, sync detected units from first car, save full form.
Workspace immediate updates/reset with current global vehicle/range effects.
Appearance theme/density/time/chart/local toggles, tour replays/reset and /?kiosk=settings.
Typography family search/preview/select, custom stack, sample text, presets/sliders/segments, optional ratio/density/HUD and reset.
Eight section resets and global reset with confirmation, cancellation and typed RESET.
dataBehavior: Hidden category panels remain mounted; hidden is intentional category navigation, not data-dependent section deletion.
Preserve existing settings query keys, AbortSignals, mutation invalidation/broadcast and independent local stores.
Do not replace missing values with measured zeros; summary configuration choices are not vehicle measurements.
Preserve raw AppSettings fields and display-only monetary formatting; no unit-suffixed fields changed or wire units inferred.
Persisted neon theme/chart options are explicit user choices and must survive visual-noise cleanup.
Do not resurrect promoted Tesla integration/account/privacy/session/Helix panels; preserve current search destinations and #ai alias.
Typography specimen fixed numbers are explicitly sample preview content, not application telemetry.
Preserve reset live-mode and sudo guards and deny-list descriptions.
preservation.previousMigration: PageLayout, OperationalBrief summary, shared typography/actions, responsive category navigation and mounted drafts are current inherited source. No source was modified or migration reverted.

evidenceLimits.backendBehavior: Only matching router declarations and hook payloads inspected; handler/repository validation, storage and mutation outcomes unverified.
